acceptanceCriteria: Exact-string anchors of the named classes in a task prompt match their source occurrences without tokenization loss, with a table-driven test per class.
Anchor hits are explained by a distinct reason string and never outrank project-owned authority rows.
The frozen retrieval evaluation shows no regression and the anchor-bearing queries are measured separately.
body: Owner requested the 2026-09 state-of-the-art gap review items as part of Corvint 0.7.0 on 2026-09-22. This ticket records release intent, not delivery or promotion. Original Go implementation; extend the cited existing mechanisms and preserve the existing public wires. Before implementation is called complete, update the owning indexed spec with stable requirements, non-goals, failure modes, acceptance evidence and rollback, and finish normal CEM/OCM, independent review and mandatory gates. Current state: the lexical tokenizer has no anchor class, so error strings, URLs, enum values, config keys and stack-frame references are split or normalized away before BM25 matching. Add an anchor class that keeps such literals verbatim as exact-match terms alongside the tokenized terms, and surface anchor hits as their own reason. Prior art: CORE-Bench arXiv 2606.11864. Owning spec: docs/specs/task-context-packet-v0.md.
title: context: preserve repository anchors verbatim in lexical queries
